title: The 2026 E-Commerce Scaling Guide
description: A comprehensive report on the shifting landscape of D2C e-commerce in the Delhi NCR region, covering AI Search (AEO), unit economics, and creative strategy.
content:
Growth Report May 2026

The 2026 E-Commerce
Scaling Guide

The playbook for scaling D2C brands in the Delhi NCR region has changed. Unit economics are tighter, customer attention is shorter, and search is no longer just about keywords.

In this comprehensive guide, we break down the three pillars of e-commerce success in 2026:

1. AEO & GEO: The New SEO

With the rise of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), brands need to optimize for how AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews consume information.

2. Creative as the Variable

In a world of automated bidding, your creative is the only lever left to pull. We explore why 'high-production' is losing to 'high-relevance' in Meta Ads strategy.

3. The Unit Economic First Principle

We detail our 'Profitability Audit' framework—ensuring your AOV and LTV support your CAC before you even think about scaling your budget.
